_doc: Text fixes applied at import time. 'find' must occur exactly once in question_text.

stem_fixes.find: Enter the ratio A : B as a single number A/B.
stem_fixes.replace: Which option gives the ratio A : B, written as the single number A/B?

stem_fixes.find: Enter your answer as a multiple of √3 (e.g. 27 if the area is 27√3).
stem_fixes.replace: If the area is k√3 cm², which option gives k?

option_shuffle._doc: Rebalance answer positions in series whose keys were skewed. Each series gets an equal share of A/B/C/D keys; option references in explanations are remapped.
